svg.title: Where Javan rhinos live
svg.desc: A simplified map of the western end of Java in Indonesia. Every Javan rhino alive lives in Ujung Kulon National Park on the far western tip of the island, roughly 1,200 square kilometres of lowland rainforest. The active volcano Anak Krakatau sits offshore in the Sunda Strait, so one eruption or tsunami is a risk to the whole species. About 50 rhinos remain, monitored by 140 camera traps in 35 clusters.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
